target_customer: Life sciences, biopharma and other regulated industry teams producing CMC and regulatory documents; also AI labs buying evaluation data
problem: Regulatory and CMC document work in drug development is slow and manual, and generic chat tools do not fit regulated workflows.
business_model: enterprise software with embedded engineering, plus an AI evaluation and training data division
product_category: AI document workspace and agent evaluation for regulated industries

founders.name: Levi Lian
founders.background_notes: Per YC company page and Every profile; sole founder listed.

technical_complexity.rationale: Document-aware agents with integrations to Veeva and SharePoint are standard LLM engineering plus domain knowledge of CMC and regulatory content.

defensibility.rationale: Embedded customer workflows and validated context are sticky, but Veeva bundles AI into Vault.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: A Sacra analysis says Veeva AI is licensed at the Vault level and runs inside the validated environment, which pressures vendors like Raycaster; dating is 2025 to 2026.

market_need_then: Founder argues the bottleneck in drug development is regulatory documentation, not discovery (Every profile); no quantified spend found.

identity.visual_style: clean technical site emphasizing traces and rubrics
identity.voice_and_tone: precise and regulated-industry oriented (Inspect the task, trace, and result)

branding.community_and_virality: Won an NVIDIA and Nebius AI-for-bio competition per the Every profile; benchmarks published openly.

brand_strength.rationale: Name is easily confused with Raycast and with a graphics term, and no brand-focused press was found; recognition rests on benchmarks.

pivots.from: agentic AI workspace for life sciences documents
pivots.to: added a division training and evaluating AI systems for AI labs and enterprises
pivots.why: YC description says it has since launched an evaluation division; reason not stated

outcome_analysis: Raycaster is a tiny New York YC Fall 2024 company led by a solo founder with Uber and Intuit experience. It reports serving publicly traded life sciences and energy companies and later added an AI evaluation division, but no round beyond YC, revenue or exit was found, so the outcome is unproven.
notes: Funding conflicts: Sacra says pre-seed on 2024-12-04 led by YC with Scale Asia Ventures, amount undisclosed; VCBacked and ZeroG say 500K; EveryDev says 130K; Sacra also shows 62.7M, treated as unreliable. All unverified, so no round recorded. YC page says founded 2025 and the job post says 2024; founded_year 2024 is the batch year. Competitor search found only 2025 to 2026 sources (Veeva AI, Peer AI, Weave Bio), nothing dated near the batch, so list is empty. Customers named in the Every profile (Agilent, Yokogawa, Genefab) are company claims.
